signup.title: Sign up
signup.passwordHint: 8 to 64 characters, including both letters and numbers.
signup.handleHint: 3 to 20 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens. You can't change it later.
signup.agreeTerms: I agree to the Terms of Service (required)
signup.agreePrivacy: I agree to the collection and use of my personal information (required)
signup.over14: I am 14 years of age or older (required)

passwordReset.title: Reset password
passwordReset.intro: Enter the email you signed up with and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
passwordReset.sent: If an account exists for that email, we've sent a reset link. The link can be used once within 30 minutes. If you don't see the email, check your spam folder.

confirm.title: Set a new password
confirm.done: Your password has been changed. You've been logged out on all devices, so please log in again.
